title: 2026 legislative race ratings · baseline test
method: Carry forward the 2024 top-two named-candidate margin, excluding write-ins, when the historical party matchup remains represented in the 2026 field. Rate only current contested races with a comparable margin of 20 percentage points or less. Incumbency is already embedded in historical results; no additional incumbent bonus is applied.
margin_definition: Difference between the top two candidates as a share of their combined votes, in percentage points. Ratings are party-level historical baselines, not candidate polling estimates.

notes: The current race has more than two candidates. This label uses the historical two-candidate baseline; third-party vote shares and vote transfers are not estimated.

The existing District 15 conditional test also starts at Toss Up under its default assumptions: zero Democratic swing, zero campaign adjustment, Fung at 20%, and half of his support taken from each major party. These third-party assumptions are adjustable, not measured support.
